name: wave-cxm
description: Wave CXM loyalty platform integration — two MCP connectors (production read-only, stage read/write) plus skills for pre-launch config verification, troubleshooting, tenant orientation, and guided authoring.

interface.shortDescription: Verify, diagnose and author Wave CXM loyalty configuration
interface.longDescription: Connects to the Wave CXM loyalty platform through two MCP connectors — production, which is read-only by construction, and stage, which also accepts allow-listed writes. Ships skills for pre-launch configuration verification, evidence-led troubleshooting, tenant orientation with permission-gap reporting, and guided authoring on stage.
